What the data says

  • Feeding is intense & cluster-heavy. ~13 feeds/day, median gap 1.0 h, median session 24 min — normal newborn cluster feeding.
  • Stool looks reassuring. mostly yellow (37 yellow vs 10 green), ~3.8/day.
  • Night load: 47% of breast-time happens in the 19:00–07:00 window (a flat clock would be 50%) — feeding is still round-the-clock with no night consolidation yet.
  • Sleep is under-logged (4.7 h/day vs the expected 14–17 h) — treat the sleep panel as a record of logging effort, not actual sleep.
  • Diapers may be under-counted (5.1/day is on the low side for a breastfed newborn) — wet-diaper count is the usual intake check, so worth logging consistently.
